sharedContext.reasoning: The agent question explicitly requests distance measurements from transformer pads to parking/vehicle areas to determine which pads fall within the 4-foot threshold, which is the primary compliance trigger. While the question also includes a presence/detail check for bollards, the measurement task (distance to parking areas) is the gating question that determines applicability of the bollard requirement.

applicableChecklistItems.checklist_deficiency_text: Equipment pad installed within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle routes lacks required 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts (bollards) per AE Design equipment pad details, or bollards not spaced to allow equipment door opening
